description: MAX7219 8x8 LED matrix on SPI1 (16-bit frames, PA5 CLK, PA7 DIN, PA4 CS/LOAD, 4.5 MHz): "OHM " scrolls left one column every 100 ms
expect:
72 MHz. SPI1 master transmit-only, 16-bit frames (DFF), mode 0, MSB first, prescaler 16: SCK 4.5 MHz on PA5, MOSI PA7 (AF push-pull); PA4 = CS/LOAD (push-pull, idle high, rising edge latches). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Prints 'MAX7219 scroll demo
', writes 0F00, 0C00, 0900, 0A04, 0B07, 0100..0800, 0C01 (one CS-low frame each) and prints 'MAX7219 ready
'. Then every 100 ms (deadline based) step s = 0, 1, 2, ...: rows 1..8 rewritten so that matrix column c (bit 7 - c of every row) shows column (s + c) mod 24 of the text 'OHM ' in a 5x7 font (5 columns + 1 blank per character, bit r of a font column = row r); every 10th step 'step N
' on USART1 right after the frame. The module needs VIH >= 0.7 x V+: run it from 4.5 V with this 3.3 V MCU (at 5 V nothing is latched).

circuit: PA5, PA7, PA4: unconnected on this bench (MAX7219 CLK / DIN / CS in the full circuit; the matrix contents are covered by tests/devices/displays-firmware.test.ts)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
MAX7219 scroll demo
MAX7219 ready
step 0
